title: Reef and Beef
description: Scotch fillet topped with a generous seafood Mornay sauce. The ultimate bistro surf and turf.

ingredients.notes: Don't add too much all at once — you can't take it out once it's in.

method.instruction: Grill or pan-fry scotch fillets over high heat to desired doneness. Remove and rest on a warm plate.
Melt butter in a saucepan over medium heat. Add flour and whisk for 1–2 minutes to cook the roux until pale golden.
Gradually add warmed milk, whisking constantly until smooth and thickened, about 3–4 minutes.
Remove from heat. Add grated cheese and stir until melted and smooth. Season with salt, white pepper, and nutmeg.
Gently fold seafood into the Mornay sauce and warm through on low heat — do not boil or the seafood will toughen.
Plate the steak and spoon the seafood Mornay generously over the top.

notes.title: Mornay Base
notes.content: No demi glace is used — this is a pure béchamel-cheese sauce. The same Mornay base is used for oysters Mornay and Veal Oscar. Keep the heat gentle once the seafood is added to prevent toughening.
